Name: DiFF (Diffusion Facial Forgery Dataset)
Notes: 500k+ images from 13 diffusion generation methods (SD v1.4/1.5/2.1/XL Midjourney DALL-E 2/3 IF LDM) + 23k real images from VoxCeleb2 & CelebA. Essential for diffusion evaluation (E9). Cited in P0023.

Name: Synthbuster Dataset
Notes: 9k synthetic images from 9 diffusion models (DALL-E 2/3 SD 1.3/1.4/2/XL GLIDE Midjourney v5 Firefly) + RAISE-1k uncompressed real images. Cited in P0003.

Name: FaceForensics++ (FF++)
Notes: 1k video sequences with face manipulations (Deepfakes Face2Face FaceSwap NeuralTextures FaceShifter). Standard baseline cited in P0005 P0007 P0022 P0028.

Name: Celeb-DF v2
Notes: 5954 video clips (890 real 5064 fake) with high-quality face swaps mitigating color artifacts. Key cross-dataset benchmark cited in P0007.

Name: DFDC (DeepFake Detection Challenge Dataset)
Notes: 100k+ video clips with diverse facial synthesis and swap algorithms across diverse demographics. Cited in P0007 P0014.

Name: CelebA-HQ
Notes: 30k high-resolution (1024x1024) real celebrity face images used as real baseline across GAN training and testing in P0005 P0015 P0023.

Name: Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ)
Notes: 70k high-quality human face PNG images at 1024x1024. Canonical real baseline for StyleGAN/StyleGAN2/StyleGAN3 (P0005 P0025).

Name: StyleGAN / StyleGAN2 Generated Faces (100k-Fake)
Notes: Synthetic face images generated using StyleGAN/StyleGAN2 trained on FFHQ. Standard GAN fake benchmark evaluated in P0005 P0010 P0015 P0021.

Name: AI-Face-FairnessBench
Notes: Comparative benchmark dataset containing real GAN-generated and Diffusion-generated face images with demographic balance. Cited in P0016.

Name: Real and Fake Face Detection Dataset
Notes: 70k real faces (FFHQ) and 70k fake faces (StyleGAN). Cited in P0002 P0011.

Name: Augmented Real and Fake Face Detection Dataset
Notes: 2041 small augmented subset derived from StyleGAN/LFW (1081 real 960 fake). Flagged as duplicate/subset of CAND0010. Cited in P0002.

Name: Guarnera Multi-Generator Face Dataset
Notes: 83k images balanced across real faces and 13 generators (9 GANs: ProGAN StyleGAN StyleGAN2 StyleGAN3 StarGAN AttGAN GDWCT GauGAN CycleGAN + 4 Diffusion: SD1.5 SD2.1 SDXL Midjourney). Cited in P0005 P0010 P0014 P0018.

Name: FakeAVCeleb
Notes: 20k+ audio-video deepfake dataset generated via SV2TTS Wav2Lip FSGAN. Multi-modal benchmark cited in P0007.

Name: CIFAKE: Real and AI-Generated Synthetic Images
Notes: 120k images (60k real 60k Stable Diffusion v1.4 fake). General synthetic benchmark cited in P0021.

Name: RAISE (Random Access Image Series Evaluator)
Notes: 8156 uncompressed camera-native real images serving as pristine uncompressed baseline in Synthbuster (P0003).

Name: VoxCeleb2 (Face Crops)
Notes: 1M+ face video tracks from 6112 speakers. Used as real face source in DiFF (P0023) and cross-dataset testing.

Name: Artifact Dataset
Notes: 2.5M images across 25 categories (real & synthetic from 13 generators: ProGAN StyleGAN2 StyleGAN3 SDv1.4 SDv1.5 SDv2.1 Midjourney VQKD). Comprehensive artifact benchmark.
